kind.description: rc-service: a session a Remote Control service ran in its worktree, run again by a one-shot LaunchDaemon; background: a claude --bg session (devhost session start), continued under its id with claude --bg --resume.

label.description: rc-service: the one-shot LaunchDaemon that runs it (com.devhost.reattach.…); background: the job id.

logPath.description: rc-service: the LaunchDaemon's log; background: the account's Claude daemon log (claude logs <jobId> shows the session).

removed.description: Earlier reattach jobs that had ended and were removed.

jobId.description: background: the id claude attach, logs, stop and rm take (the same as before).
